title: Eye of Breaking the Game
next_chapter_hook: Although the Heavenly Secrets Eye's pupil had closed, that gaze transcending human will was branded into the depths of Chen Ji's soul—like the next descent would not merely be a probe, but true annihilation.

text.content:
Golden light like blades, tearing through the heavens.

Chen Ji felt an intense pain in his brow center, as if a burning branding iron was searing his forehead. The Tianji Record Fragment rose uncontrollably from his skin, radiating light even more blinding than the scorching sun, engulfing him entirely.

That was a pressure surpassing human will—the Heavenly Secrets Eye had opened its pupil.

Above the nine heavens, in the void, a colossal eye spanning ten thousand miles gazed coldly down upon the earth. Countless scenes swirled within its pupil—the fates of all living beings, the tracks of karma and reincarnation, the chess game the heavens had woven for millennia.

And now, its gaze fell upon Chen Ji.

Chen Ji felt the blood throughout his body flowing backward.

The Heavenly Secrets Eye's pressure differed from any opponent he had faced—the suppression was not of spiritual energy, not of momentum, but a gaze from a higher dimension, as if all his secrets, calculations, and schemes were laid bare before those pupils.

"Tianji Record holder detected."

A cold voice descended from the nine heavens, not language but will directly poured into his soul: "Anomaly detected. Initiating elimination protocol."

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Elimination protocol—these four words meant the Heavenly Secrets Eye had never intended to give him a way out from the start.

dialogue.content:
"Don't panic!"

Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly exploded in his mind, carrying unprecedented urgency: "The Heavenly Secrets Eye's elimination protocol requires three breaths to lock onto your causal thread—this is your only chance!"

Chen Ji gritted his teeth, and amid the intense brow center pain, he felt the Tianji Record Fragment vibrating frantically, as if competing with some force for control of his body.

text.content:
Three breaths.

Chen Ji had never felt time pass so slowly. Each breath seemed infinitely stretched, his consciousness falling into chaos—the Tianji Record Fragment auto-activated, presenting the possibilities of the next three hours like a carousel before his eyes.

First breath: He attempts to flee, pierced through the back by a beam of golden light, dying on the spot.
Second breath: He chooses to resist the pressure, his divine soul collapses, becoming a walking corpse.
Third breath: He attempts to communicate with the Heavenly Secrets Eye, his intellect erased, becoming the most humble piece in the heavenly chess game.

For three entire breaths, Chen Ji witnessed seventeen types of death.

Seventeen types of death, none where he survived.

Sweat dripped from Chen Ji's forehead, but the corner of his mouth lifted slightly. Among those seventeen types of death, he saw some subtle changes—in each type of death, the Heavenly Secrets Eye needed to consume power to "write" his causal ending.

And writing itself meant acknowledgment.

Acknowledging him as a variable worthy of being "eliminated."

"I understand." Chen Ji said quietly, his voice hoarse but exceptionally calm: "You're afraid of me."

dialogue.content:
The Heavenly Secrets Eye's pupil slightly contracted, that colossal eye spanning ten thousand miles seemed to be examining an ant attempting to shake a great tree.

Cold will descended once more: "Interesting. A piece, actually questioning the chess player's will?"

Chen Ji smiled.

That was a composed, strategic smile, entirely different from his usual waste-of-space persona—now in Chen Ji's eyes, there was not a trace of fear, only absolute calm and calculation.

choice.prompt: Seventeen death traps already before him, Chen Ji had to make a choice in that lightning flash—how to turn this inescapable situation into a trap for the Heavenly Secrets Eye instead?

choices.description: Burn a large amount of Heavenly Fate, forcibly entangle one's own fate line with the Heavenly Secrets Eye, a mutual destruction strike
choices.visible_reward: Inflict heavy damage on the Heavenly Secrets Eye, buying breathing room
choices.risk_hint: When Heavenly Fate is extremely low, will trigger a death debuff

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath and stopped resisting the Tianji Record Fragment's guidance.

He actively burned his Heavenly Fate—that was the source of life, the cornerstone of destiny. A full fifty points of Heavenly Fate transformed into blazing golden light, erupting from within him!

"You want to eliminate me?" Chen Ji's voice carried mockery: "Then let me see—are you willing to exchange your pupil power for it?"

Golden light shot upward, transforming into a scorching chain, shooting toward the Heavenly Secrets Eye's pupil!

choices.text: Break the Game with a Game—Preset Trap
choices.description: Use the Tianji Record's foresight ability to bury traps in the future the Heavenly Secrets Eye "sees," making it eat its own fruit
choices.visible_reward: Drag the Heavenly Secrets Eye into a backlash loop, permanently weakening part of its abilities
choices.risk_hint: Requires perfect prediction of the Heavenly Secrets Eye's reactions
choices.process_label: scheme for future, rebel against heaven

text.content:
A cold smile curved at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth.

He activated the Tianji Record Fragment once more, this time not to foresee his own fate, but to reverse the operation—he wanted to let the Heavenly Secrets Eye "see" the scenes he wanted it to see.

"Don't you like watching?" Chen Ji murmured: "Then watch all you want."

The Tianji Record Fragment radiated a strange purple-gold light, a carefully designed "script" beginning to infiltrate the Heavenly Secrets Eye's pupil—that was the fate he designed for himself.

One it absolutely could not stand by and ignore.

choices.text: Borrow Strength to Strike—Summon Demonic Path Mist
choices.description: Utilize the alliance with Ye Qing, using Demonic Path mist to conceal the Tianji Record's aura, temporarily disappearing from the Heavenly Secrets Eye's sight
choices.visible_reward: Safely escape, but Ye Qing's location will be exposed to the Heavenly Secrets Eye
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing will face locking from the Heavenly Secrets Eye

text.content:
A trace of hesitation flickered in Chen Ji's eyes, but was quickly replaced by resolve.

He quietly activated the contract inscribed within the Tianji Record—the Demonic Path pact between him and Ye Qing. A secret transmission pierced the void, arriving at the Demonic Path Saintess thousands of miles away.

A moment later, dense black fog surged from all directions, wrapping Chen Ji entirely. That was Ye Qing's "Demonic Path Mist," capable of concealing all heavenly secrets and induction.

"I'm sorry, Ye Qing." Chen Ji whispered in his heart: "I'll remember this favor."

Within the mist, his aura completely vanished from the Heavenly Secrets Eye's sight.

The Heavenly Secrets Eye's pupil contracted violently.

It saw—within that carefully designed "script," Chen Ji was not walking toward death, but toward an ending capable of shaking the heavens' foundation.

Within the web of fate woven by the Heavenly Secrets Eye, there existed a hidden causal thread connecting it to each generation of Tianji Record holders. That causal thread was the foundation of its control over prophets—once corrupted, it would lose absolute control over the Tianji Record.

"Impossible!"

For the first time, fluctuation appeared in the cold will: "How could a mere ant possibly corrupt causality in reverse—"

But its words stopped abruptly.

Because it saw that causal thread being "corrupted" by Chen Ji's script.

Chen Ji smiled.

That was a confident, strategic smile, entirely different from his usual waste-of-space persona. Now in his eyes, there was not a trace of fear, only absolute calm and calculation.

"Your mistake was making me a chess piece."

Chen Ji's voice was not loud, yet it clearly spread across the entire heaven and earth: "But you forgot one thing—the Tianji Record chose me, not you. It lets me see the future, but it never said I can only see my own future."

He raised his hand, pointing at the Heavenly Secrets Eye's pupil: "Now, let me show you the 'script' I prepared for you."

Purple-gold light erupted from the fragment, transforming into a scorching chain, shooting toward the Heavenly Secrets Eye's pupil!

dialogue.content:
A trace of... fear? flickered within the Heavenly Secrets Eye's pupil.

That was an emotional fluctuation beyond human understanding, but it did exist—within the chess game the heavens had woven for millennia, it had never been countered by its own chess piece.

"No... this is impossible..."

An unprecedented crack appeared in the cold voice: "You're just a fragment... how could you possibly—"

The purple-gold chain pierced through the Heavenly Secrets Eye's pupil, burning countless cracks into that colossal eye spanning ten thousand miles!

text.content:
The Heavenly Secrets Eye let out a heaven-shaking roar.

That was not language, but pure collapse of will—it was suffering backlash at the causal level. Countless images burst forth from the pupil, those were the "fate scripts" it had written over millennia, now scattering like torn pages.

"Remember this."

Chen Ji's voice was cold and mocking: "This is the gift from the 'chess piece' you looked down upon."

His face was pale as paper, the cost of burning Heavenly Fate nearly making him collapse, yet he stood straight—as if in that instant, he was eye-to-eye with the heavens above the nine heavens, not at all at a disadvantage.

"Hmph."

The Heavenly Secrets Eye let out a cold hum, that colossal eye spanning ten thousand miles finally began to dissipate. But in the moment before its disappearance, a cold will descended once more:

"Very well. This One... remembers you."

"The next descent will not be a probe."

Golden light completely dissipated, the heavens restored to their original color. But Chen Ji knew this was only temporary peace—the Heavenly Secrets Eye had already noticed him, and the next time would be true annihilation.

He lowered his head, looking at his own hands, and laughed bitterly.

"The cost truly wasn't small..."

The Tianji Record Fragment sank into his brow center once more, but this time Chen Ji felt its weight—as if an invisible shackle was being fitted onto his soul.

dialogue.content:
"You're insane."

Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded in his mind, carrying unprecedented gravity: "Do you have any idea how dangerous what you just did was? Causal backlash... the Heavenly Secrets Eye has now added you to its kill list."

Chen Ji leaned against the boulder behind him, gasping for breath: "I know."

"And you still did it?!"

"Because if I did nothing, I'd be dead right now." Chen Ji closed his eyes, the corner of his mouth lifting slightly: "At least now, I've left the Heavenly Secrets Eye a 'souvenir'—it can no longer manipulate my fate as freely as before."

Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment: "...What's the cost?"

"Every time I use the Tianji Record's foresight ability, I get a splitting headache for three days." Chen Ji opened his eyes, his tone relaxed as if speaking of someone else's affairs: "And it remembered me. The next time we meet, there won't be any probe."

text.content:
The sound of hurried footsteps came from afar.

The disciples of Tianqing Sect had finally arrived. What they saw was a battlefield in ruins—Jin Dan stage disciples lay scattered on the ground, while Chen Ji, the waste everyone had ridiculed, stood intact among the wreckage.

"C-Chen Ji?! Are you alright?" An outer disciple stammered, disbelief evident in his eyes.

Chen Ji raised his head, offering a weak but gentle smile: "I'm fine, just... a bit tired."

His gaze swept across the crowd, catching several malicious glances from a certain corner—those who had framed him, now staring at him in shock, as if seeing something unbelievable.

Chen Jisneered in his heart.

Framing conspiracy? Did they think he didn't know?

Remembered. When the time is right, none of you will escape.

"Make way! Everyone make way!"

A cold voice came from behind the crowd. Everyone turned to look, seeing Su Qingyao in a white robe, arriving like frost and snow upon rippling waters. Her gaze fell on Chen Ji, her brow slightly furrowing.

"You're hurt?"

"Thanks to Senior Sister's福, I barely survived." Chen Ji bowed respectfully, his posture so humble it was impeccable.

Su Qingyao deeply looked at him, a hint of inquiry flickering in her gaze. She stepped closer, lowering her voice: "That golden light just now... what was it?"

Chen Ji raised his head, meeting her gaze.

In those clear, cold eyes, there was no fear, no panic, only determination and curiosity—and a trace of... concern.

"I don't know." Chen Ji smiled, his tone sincere: "Perhaps the sect's protective formation was triggered."

Su Qingyao's brow furrowed even tighter. She always felt something was off, but couldn't put her finger on it.

"...You'd better not be lying to me." She said quietly, then turned and left.

Chen Ji watched her retreating figure, a complex light flickering in his eyes.

The crowd gradually dispersed, leaving only the ruins and a solitary figure.

Chen Ji sat on a broken stone pillar, looking up at the gradually calming heavens. The Heavenly Secrets Eye had vanished, but that sensation of being watched still lingered in his soul—like an invisible gaze was tightly fixed on him from some unknown corner.

"Next time will be true annihilation..."

He murmured to himself, yet his voice held not a trace of fear.

Chen Ji closed his eyes, his consciousness sinking into the Tianji Record Fragment. There, Mo Xiansheng's figure loomed faintly, as if it might dissipate at any moment.

"Mo Xiansheng."

"Hmm."

"What exactly is the Heavenly Secrets Eye?"

Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment, then sighed: "Wait until you're ready to ask that question. Right now, you need rest."

"I'm ready."

"No, you're not." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a trace of fatigue: "After you truly understand the complete truth of the Tianji Record... you'll regret what you did today."

Chen Ji opened his eyes, determination flickering within: "I won't. Because every choice I make is to survive."

On the main peak of Tianqing Sect far away, in Elder Ling Yuan's cave dwelling, a soul lamp quietly flickered on.

"Interesting..."

An aged yet cold voice echoed in the cave dwelling: "The Heavenly Secrets Eye personally intervened and still couldn't kill him... Chen Ji, Chen Ji, how many secrets are you hiding?"

A withered hand slowly gripped the armrest, the joints making cracking sounds.

"It seems... it's time to accelerate the schedule."

Meanwhile, a thousand miles away.

The Demonic Path Saintess Ye Qing stood in a dark valley, her form surrounded by faint black mist. Her complexion was somewhat pale, clearly the Demonic Path Mist just now had consumed much of her energy.

"The Heavenly Secrets Eye... actually intervened personally."

She murmured, complex light flickering in her eyes. That waste-like Chen Ji could actually attract the Heavenly Secrets Eye's attention, even causing it to descend personally—what did that mean?

"Interesting..."

A playful smile curved at Ye Qing's lips: "It seems my choice back then wasn't wrong. This man is more valuable than I imagined."

She raised her head, gazing toward Tianqing Sect, her eyes growing brighter.

"Chen Ji... how many more surprises can you give me?"

And in a corner of Tianqing Sect, Chen Ji stood beneath the moonlight, gazing at a faint golden pattern on his palm—the mark left by the Heavenly Secrets Eye, proof that he had been "remembered."

"Next time we meet..."

He clenched his fist, a sharp edge flickering in his eyes.

"I won't let you escape so easily this time."

Beneath the moonlight, the youth's figure was solitary yet stubborn.

A greater storm was brewing.

The Tianji Record Fragment sank into his brow center once more, but this time Chen Ji felt an unprecedented heaviness—as if an invisible shackle was tightening with each use.

A splitting headache.

That was the cost of foresight into the next three hours—each use would cause his soul to endure tearing agony. Mo Xiansheng said the Tianji Record was "collecting fees"—but he had never told Chen Ji where these fees would ultimately lead him.

But at this moment, Chen Ji couldn't worry about these things.

Because he noticed one thing—among all the death traps he had foreseen just now, there was one image blurred and unclear, as if deliberately obscured by some force.

In that image, there was a figure incredibly familiar to him.

"Xiao Nian..."

Chen Ji murmured quietly, a hint of tenderness and resolve flickering in his eyes.

No matter how terrifying the Heavenly Secrets Eye, no matter how heavy the Tianji Record's cost—he would find her.

Even if it meant becoming an enemy of heaven itself.
